data.template.narx-pending:
github:
  repoURLPath: "{{.app.spec.source.repoURL}}"
  revisionPath: "{{.app.status.sync.revision}}"
  status:
    state: pending
    label: 'narx/deploy-{{index .app.metadata.labels "delivery.narx.space/environment"}}'
data.trigger.narx-pending:
- description: Commerce pending deployment evidence
  oncePer: "app.status.sync.revision + ':' + app.status.operationState.startedAt + ':' + (app.status.health.lastTransitionTime ?? '')"
  send: [narx-pending]
  when: app.status.operationState != nil && app.status.operationState.phase == 'Running'
data.template.narx-healthy:
github:
  repoURLPath: "{{.app.spec.source.repoURL}}"
  revisionPath: "{{.app.status.sync.revision}}"
  status:
    state: success
    label: 'narx/deploy-{{index .app.metadata.labels "delivery.narx.space/environment"}}'
data.trigger.narx-healthy:
- description: Commerce healthy deployment evidence
  oncePer: "app.status.sync.revision + ':' + app.status.operationState.startedAt + ':' + (app.status.health.lastTransitionTime ?? '')"
  send: [narx-healthy]
  when: app.status.operationState != nil && app.status.operationState.phase == 'Succeeded' && app.status.sync.status == 'Synced' && app.status.health.status == 'Healthy'
data.template.narx-failed:
github:
  repoURLPath: "{{.app.spec.source.repoURL}}"
  revisionPath: "{{.app.status.sync.revision}}"
  status:
    state: failure
    label: 'narx/deploy-{{index .app.metadata.labels "delivery.narx.space/environment"}}'
data.trigger.narx-failed:
- description: Commerce failed deployment evidence
  oncePer: "app.status.sync.revision + ':' + app.status.operationState.startedAt + ':' + (app.status.health.lastTransitionTime ?? '')"
  send: [narx-failed]
  when: app.status.operationState != nil && (app.status.operationState.phase in ['Error', 'Failed'] || app.status.health.status == 'Degraded')
